description: This file is part of the 'spew' package and provides wrapper functions around fmt package functions, converting arguments to a default Formatter interface via NewFormatter. It facilitates formatted output with custom formatting logic.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Creates an error string with formatted arguments, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Fprint
methods.description: Prints to an io.Writer, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Fprintf
methods.description: Formats and writes to an io.Writer, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Fprintln
methods.description: Prints to an io.Writer with newline, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints to standard output, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Formats and prints to standard output, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Println
methods.description: Prints to standard output with newline, converting each argument to a Formatter.

methods.name: Sprint
methods.description: Returns a string with arguments converted to Formatters.

methods.name: Sprintf
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with arguments converted to Formatters.

methods.name: Sprintln
methods.description: Returns a string with arguments converted to Formatters, separated by spaces.

methods.name: convertArgs
methods.description: Converts a slice of arguments to a slice where each argument is wrapped with NewFormatter.
